name: Concept Networks
summary: Fremantle/Perth WA ISP trading as 'Concept Networks' on conceptual.net.au (Conceptual Internet Australia Pty Ltd, ABN 49 087 624 619, formerly Genium Pty Ltd); dial-up, ADSL broadband, web hosting, domain names and web design; business names included Nerd Net, Smiley's Internet Services, Pips.net.au; wound down by the 2010s.

events.details: Genium Pty Ltd registered 1 Nov 1999, trading as Concept Networks; renamed Conceptual Internet Australia Pty Ltd (ABN 49 087 624 619, WA); earliest Wayback capture of conceptual.net.au Aug 2000. ABR records the trading name GENIUM.NET from 28 Apr 2000 and CONCEPTUAL INTERNET AUSTRALIA PTY LTD from 27 Mar 2002.
Last live retail Wayback capture of conceptual.net.au Apr 2009 (later captures parked/redirect); ABN 49 087 624 619 cancelled 5 Apr 2017.
